heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: Of the amounts authorized under section 1968(a) of this title, the Secretary of Commerce shall use up to $1,000,000 to carry out this subchapter.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 4236 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 119–65.
